_comment: Synthetic POA&M entries — mix of valid and invalid for testing. Includes deliberate errors: one 5-point control (should fail), one excluded 1-point, one vague entry.

entries.weakness: No mechanism to limit unsuccessful login attempts on workstations running Windows 11 Pro
entries.current_state: Windows workstations allow unlimited login attempts; no account lockout policy configured in Group Policy
entries.target_state: Account lockout after 3 failed attempts with 15-minute lockout duration on all CUI-processing workstations
entries.tasks: 1. Configure Group Policy: Account Lockout Threshold = 3, Duration = 15 min. 2. Apply to CUI Workstations OU. 3. Test with non-admin account. 4. Document in SSP AC.L2-3.1.8.
entries.resources: IT admin (Jane Smith) — 2 hours. No additional cost.
entries.milestones: GPO created by 2026-06-15; tested by 2026-06-30; documented by 2026-07-15

entries.weakness: No audit logging — this is a 5-point control and should NOT be in POA&M
CUI connections not verified — this 1-point control is excluded from POA&M
No system maintenance procedures — 3-point control, should NOT be in POA&M
Encryption in use but not FIPS 140-2 validated — using AES-256 via OpenSSL but module not on CMVP validated list
entries.current_state: AES-256 encryption via OpenSSL 3.0 on all CUI storage; TLS 1.3 for transit. Neither module is FIPS 140-2 validated.
entries.target_state: Replace with FIPS 140-2 validated modules: Windows CNG (cert #4515) for workstations, AWS-LC FIPS (cert #4631) for cloud services
entries.tasks: 1. Enable Windows FIPS mode via GPO on CUI workstations (2 hrs). 2. Switch S3 bucket to AWS SSE-S3 with AWS-LC FIPS module (1 hr). 3. Verify FIPS status via Get-FIPSStatus and AWS CLI. 4. Update SSP SC.L2-3.13.11 narrative with certificate numbers.
entries.resources: Jane Smith (4 hrs). No additional licensing cost — FIPS modules included in Windows and AWS.
entries.milestones: GPO applied 2026-06-15; S3 migrated 2026-06-30; verification complete 2026-07-15; SSP updated 2026-07-30
